blocks.title: Standard enthalpy change of atomization
blocks.text: Kisi unsur ki standard enthalpy change of atomization, delta Hat, woh enthalpy tabdeeli hai jab standard halaat ke tehat unsur se gaseous atoms ka ek mole bane.
Hydrogen ke liye, H2(g) se 2H(g) H-H bond energy +436 kJ fi mol ke saath, to 1/2 H2(g) se H(g) delta Hat = +218 kJ fi mol ke saath: diatomic unsur ki atomization us ki bond energy ka aadha hai.

blocks.prompt: Oxygen, barium aur bromine ki atomization ki enthalpy tabdeeli ke muadle state symbols ke saath likhein.
blocks.explanation: Oxygen: 1/2 O2(g) se O(g). Barium: Ba(s) se Ba(g). Bromine: 1/2 Br2(l) se Br(g). Har ek apni standard state mein unsur se gaseous atoms ka ek mole banata hai.

items: Delta Hat: unsur se gaseous atoms ka ek mole, hamesha endothermic; hydrogen ke liye +218 kJ fi mol, 436 ki H-H bond energy ka aadha.
